title: geoDB Open Exploration Protocol — xpl STAC extension
description: The exploration vocabulary for STAC items: geophysical surveys, drillhole packages, and assay certificates. Part of the geoDB Open Exploration Protocol. All fields are OPTIONAL and only meaningful on the item profile(s) they belong to.

xpl:method.title: Geophysical method
xpl:method.description: Physical measurement type of the survey.

xpl:acquisition_type.title: Acquisition platform
xpl:acquisition_type.description: How the survey was acquired (ground / airborne / downhole).

xpl:line_spacing_m.title: Nominal line spacing (m)
xpl:line_spacing_m.description: Nominal survey line spacing in metres.

xpl:survey_date_start.title: Survey start date
xpl:survey_date_start.description: First day of data acquisition (ISO 8601 date).

xpl:survey_date_end.title: Survey end date
xpl:survey_date_end.description: Last day of data acquisition (ISO 8601 date).

xpl:footprint_source.title: Footprint provenance
xpl:footprint_source.description: How the survey footprint polygon was derived.

xpl:specs.title: Method-specific acquisition parameters
xpl:specs.description: Free-form method-specific specs (frequency, base station, sample interval, tie-line spacing, ...).

xpl:hole_id.title: Drillhole ID
xpl:hole_id.description: Collar / hole identifier of a drillhole package.

xpl:hole_type.title: Hole type
xpl:hole_type.description: Drilling method (e.g. DD diamond, RC reverse-circulation).

xpl:total_depth_m.title: Total depth (m)
xpl:total_depth_m.description: Final drilled depth of the hole in metres.

xpl:sample_count.title: Sample count
xpl:sample_count.description: Number of samples in the drillhole package.

xpl:laboratory.title: Laboratory
xpl:laboratory.description: Assaying laboratory that issued the certificate.

xpl:elements.title: Reported elements
xpl:elements.description: Element symbols reported on the certificate.
